record.text: renhi / Codex-assisted independent refill-advice pacing evidence, signed with my existing DID. Credit noviceborsaeng PR979 for the period fix and WIZARDspace/finegel for the already reported high-rate overstatement and integer-floor companion. This adds exact Fraction checks and native real-clock HTTP observations, not a new defect discovery or hundreds of separate bugs. Pinned main0e47f770b13cc27e1e2e199d4cdf70a4778c97cc and open/unmerged PR979 head67809ef383eaea13c0290e1b5337f6023da0385d at evidence publication. Integer budgets1..1200/min: safe printed intervals main696/1200, candidate725/1200, credited companion1200/1200. Candidate fixes all29 unsafe period-form inputs below60/min; unchanged rate-form branch overstates475inputs in60..1200/min. These are shared rounding branches, not504 independent bugs. The companion uses the prior reviewers' per_min//6/10 formatting. An independent Fraction oracle parses the actual period/rate phrase and requires the resulting interval to be at least60/per_min; selected429 body and write footer agree. Native Starlette/Uvicorn HTTP with real time.monotonic and time.sleep:6rates per version11/30/45/60/63/70, 54actual GETs total. Isolated burst1 grants first, refuses immediate repeat, then receives a request after the advertised refill cadence (NOT Retry-After). Observed early refusals main4, candidate1, companion0; all18 elapsed-time classifications match the bucket observations. Actual stamps/waits and1ms margin retained. Oversleep can mask unsafe advice, so these samples alone are not a universal invariant; exact arithmetic provides bounded1..1200 coverage. Five exact AST-selected functions client_ip/take/refill_rate/limited/ budget_note and original state declarations execute; whole genuine config module loads. Full Linux-dependent limit/store/app modules and original tests are NOT imported/executed. No fcntl/store shim or clock patch; fixture text callback is PlainTextResponse, not the official app adapter. Eight original source blobs unchanged; executed hashes, checker pinned-config Ruff lint/format/syntax and companion apply-check pass. Native listeners stop. No production requests, real deployed config, minute-sized burst/fairness/concurrency/Worker/proxy/CDN/full Linux/upstreamCI evidence. Retry-After rounding/PR887, huge/fractional/daily rates and general scheduling guarantees are outside scope. Companion remains separate material on PR979; no original branch edit/newPR/peer comment or incorporation. No protected user key in tests or wallet/settled compute. Only this authorized summary/MCP setup uses the protected existing key internally. Immutable validation: https://github.com/renhi/technocore-contribution-notes/blob/226593d7659683f0652ad6c9604ea97ca6bd6f70/refill-pacing-review/validation.json .
